verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs say you can host an instance of the platform in your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering, with trace and operational data staying in your environment. Helm configuration guidance for self-hosted Agent Server deployments backs this up. Community wishes for a lighter local-first tool show demand for something simpler, but they do not concretely contradict the documented self-hosted offering. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of a self-hosted install, and documented install requirements and licensing terms for the self-hosted platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Host an instance of LangSmith in your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering.
Self-hosted LangSmith runs the LangSmith platform in your own infrastructure so that trace and operational data stay in your environment.
Tune the Agent Server for self-hosted deployments—write load, read load, and example Helm configurations for different load patterns.
